content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 prior auth missing; retro-auth window (14 days) is closed, no peer-to-peer offered, and an appeal with necessity was already filed unsuccessfully. Resubmitting risks CO-18 duplicate denial and no clean path remains for payer collection. Patient share is only the deductible, not the full balance, so billing the patient the whole amount isn't proper. With no viable action to progress collection, this uncollectible auth failure should be written off (provider's error, non-billable to patient).","action":"write_off"}
